spans.s: मुंज m. 1. A sort of rush; (it is used for the girdle of a Brāhmaṇa), M.ii.43; 2. name of a king of Dhārā, uncle of the celebrated Bhoja.
मुंज-केश m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. of Viṣṇu.
मुंज-केशिन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
मुंज-बंधन n. investiture with the sacred thread or girdle.
मुंज-वासस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
मुंजर n. the fibrous root of the lotus.
मुंड (I) a. (f. डा) 1. Low, mean; 2. shaved, bald.

मुंड (II) m. 1. A man with a bald head; 2. a bald head; 3. the forehead; 4. a barber; 5. an epithet of Rāhu; 6. the trunk of a tree stripped of leaves and branches; 7. a mendicant of a particular order.
मुंड (III) n. 1. The head; 2. iron.
मुंड (I) a. (f. डा) 1. Low, mean; 2. shaved, bald.
मुंड-अयस n. iron.
मुंड-फल m. a cocoanut tree.
मुंड-लोह n. iron.
मुंड-शालि m. a kind of rice.
मुंडक (I) m. 1. A barber; 2. the trunk of a tree stripped of its branches.
मुंडक (II) n. the head.
मुंडक-उपनिषद् f. name of an Upanishad of the Atharvaveda.
मुंडन n. Shaving the head.
मुंडित (I) a. (f. ता) Shaved.
मुंडित (II) n. Iron.
मुंडित (I) a. (f. ता) Shaved.
मुंडिन् m. 1. A barber; 2. an epithet of Śiva.

मुनि m. 1. A sage, a holy man, a devotee, a recluse, पुण्यः शब्दो मुनिरिति मुहुः केवलं राजपूर्वः Sak.ii., R.i.8, iii.49, Rt.vi.31, Bg.ii.56; 2. the mango tree; 3. an epithet of Agastya; 4. of Buddha; 5. the number ‘seven.’
मुनि-अन्न n. pl. the food of ascetics.
मुनि-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. a great sage.
मुनि-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. a great sage.
मुनि-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. a great sage.
मुनि-त्रय n. the triad of sages (inspired writers on grammar) viz., Pāṇini, Kātyāyana and Patanjali, मुनित्रयं नमस्कृत्य S.K.
मुनि-पित्तल n. copper.
मुनि-पुंगव m. a great sage.
मुनि-पुत्रक m. 1. a wagtail; 2. the Damanaka tree.
मुनि-भेषज n. 1. the fruit of the yellow myrobalan; 2. fasting.
मुंथ् vt. 1P (pres. मुंथति) To go, to move.
